confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on crowd-sourced Expatistan Kunming estimates last updated May 2024, plus one MyLifeElsewhere and one CostLiving data point, so they are rough and possibly dated. Cappuccino and beer are the better-supported anchors. Wine glass is weakly sourced: no glass price was found, so it is bounded from a bottle price and the local beer relationship. The mid-range three-course figure is inferred from a two-person Italian dinner listing and local Chinese meal patterns, not a direct local three-course price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Kunming and mid-sized Chinese cities; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I could not verify directly against the table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used for the core anchors. Food and drink are based on Kunming-specific listings, converted at roughly 7.1 CNY per USD. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from typical budget and mid-tier hotel and hostel rates in second-tier Chinese cities such as Kunming, not from any city comparison or live data.
